title: Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP)
description: Runnable companion for the 2FA/TOTP recipe: enroll + confirm + verify endpoints, AES-256-GCM secret storage, hashed single-use backup codes, and rate-limited verification with pytest coverage.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la receta 2FA/TOTP: endpoints enroll + confirm + verify, almacenamiento de secretos AES-256-GCM, códigos de respaldo hasheados de un solo uso y verificación con rate limit y cobertura pytest.
